summary: Describes an experimental way to run SNMP directly on Ethernet frames rather than on UDP and IP. It is meant for local network devices that support nothing above the MAC layer. It was replaced by RFC 4789.

eli5.summary: Normally you mail a letter with a full address. Here a device that can only shout across one room is given a simple way to be checked on, without the full mail system.

questions: run snmp without udp or ip
subtitle: Direct management of devices that have no IP support.

tldr.problem: Some network devices like repeaters and switches have intelligence but no UDP or IP support, yet they need to be managed.
tldr.mechanism: Send SNMP messages directly in Ethernet frames using a reserved Ethernet type field (0x814C), bypassing the UDP/IP stack entirely.
tldr.outcome: Devices with only MAC-layer support can be monitored and controlled with SNMP. The approach was experimental and largely superseded by RFC 4789.

today: RFC 1089 is experimental and was replaced by RFC 4789.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.content:
SNMP usually travels inside UDP packets, which sit inside IP packets. But many local area network devices—repeaters, hubs, wiring concentrators—have no software for IP or UDP. They only understand Ethernet MAC-layer frames. Yet these devices have intelligence and can be managed; they are just invisible without a proprietary way to talk to them.

This RFC solves the problem by defining how to wrap SNMP messages directly in Ethernet frames, skipping the whole UDP/IP stack. It is useful for LAN-only devices that support addressability but nothing above the MAC sublayer.
sections.eli5: Some machines only understand the simplest kind of message: an Ethernet frame. This shows how to put SNMP inside one.

sections.title: The Ethernet Encapsulation
sections.content:
The specification follows the same style used for IP over Ethernet (RFC 894, RFC 1042). It assigns Ethernet type 0x814C (33100 decimal) to SNMP. A standard SNMP message becomes the data payload of an Ethernet frame with that type field.

No modification to the SNMP message itself is needed. The message is the same as defined in RFC 1067; only the encapsulation changes. Devices on a shared Ethernet segment can address each other directly because Ethernet provides both addressability and bidirectional flow.
sections.eli5: An Ethernet frame carries data with a type number. SNMP over Ethernet uses type 0x814C to say 'the data inside is an SNMP message.'

sections.title: Scope and Status
sections.content: This approach is experimental and meant for local area networks where devices have no higher-layer protocol support. It does not modify SNMP itself, only the transport. The technique applies to any network element that can address other elements on the MAC layer and has programmable intelligence, such as bridges and managed switches.
sections.eli5: This is an experimental way to manage local-only devices. It works because Ethernet already lets devices find and talk to each other.
